## Summary

The business-day rule in `src/main/java/org/springframework/samples/petclinic/util/BusinessDay.java` previously only rolled weekends forward (Sat→+2, Sun→+1). I extended `adjust` to also skip the fixed public holidays.

Key points of the implementation:
- Added the holiday set `2026-01-01, 2026-01-26, 2026-04-25, 2026-12-25, 2026-12-28`.
- Replaced the one-shot weekend jump with an iterative roll-forward (`plusDays(1)` until the date is neither a weekend nor a listed holiday). This correctly handles chains — e.g. `2026-12-25` (Fri holiday) → `26` (Sat) → `27` (Sun) → `28` (holiday) → `29` (Tue business day).

This matches the roll logic the test harness replicates in `AcceptanceBase.toBusinessDay`, and it flows through both existing call sites (`BuildOwner` for the stored date and `EnsureBelowDailyLimit` for the counting key). `./mvnw test` reports **BUILD SUCCESS** with all tests passing.
